preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(parents) == n - 1 and all(0 <= p <= i for i, p in enumerate(parents))
preconditions.description: The parents list has n-1 integers where the i-th integer (0-indexed) is between 0 and i, defining a valid tree structure rooted at 0.

preconditions.expression: len(colors) == n and all(c in (0, 1) for c in colors)
preconditions.description: The colors list has n integers, each being 0 (white) or 1 (black).
There is at least one black vertex in the tree.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the count modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == (sum(1 for edges_subset in all_edge_subsets if is_valid_split(n, parents, colors, edges_subset)) % 1000000007)
postconditions.description: The output equals the number of edge subsets such that removing them splits the tree into connected components where each component contains exactly one black vertex, modulo 10^9 + 7.
